title: USB hotplug: detect token insertion and removal
description:
wolfP11 currently enumerates USB slots once at C_Initialize and hardcodes CKF_TOKEN_PRESENT. C_WaitForSlotEvent returns CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED. This is wrong for desktop/interactive use where tokens are hot-swapped.

What needs to be done:
- Register a libusb_hotplug_register_callback at C_Initialize time to track arrival and departure of known VID/PID pairs from the token database
- On arrival: add a new slot to g_slots[], open the CCID context, set CKF_TOKEN_PRESENT
- On departure: mark the slot's token absent (clear CKF_TOKEN_PRESENT), close the CCID context, release the slot
- C_WaitForSlotEvent: implement blocking (CKF_DONT_BLOCK not set) and polling (CKF_DONT_BLOCK set) modes using the libusb hotplug event queue
- C_GetSlotInfo must reflect live token-present state, not a snapshot from init time
- Thread safety: hotplug callback fires on a libusb event thread; slot state updates must be protected by g_lock

Scope: local USB devices only (libusb LIBUSB_HOTPLUG_ENUMERATE covers devices already present at init).
